D010-D005_h001.question:
It’s been going on for more than a year now, I think. The worst part is the voices and… sensations. Even when I’m alone in the cab, I feel like someone’s touching my arm or crawling on my skin, but there’s nothing there. The radio, the ads on the bus stops, even people crossing the street—I keep feeling like they’re sending me messages just for me, like they’re talking about me or warning me.

There was a period, maybe two months, when I was really wound up and snappy. Small things from passengers would set me off, I’d shout over nothing. I couldn’t sit still—pacing in my flat, fiddling with my hands, needing to keep driving even when I was exhausted. I’d talk so fast my dispatcher and my ex said they couldn’t follow me. I also started buying stuff online—gadgets, car parts—blew through my savings and ran up debt. That revved‑up phase has settled down now, but the weird beliefs and the feeling of being touched are still there.

Lately I feel… empty. I don’t enjoy driving, football, nothing. It’s like my feelings are switched off. Even choosing what to eat or what route to take feels overwhelming. I’ve missed a lot of work because of all this.
